item.title: Norway imposes near ban on AI in elementary school
Court Records Should Be Free
item.description:
📝 Court records belong to the public. Supporters note that PACER currently collects more than $150 million annually in fees from the public, despite court records being public documents. The Open Courts Act would also make court records easier to find, access, and understand.
🔗 Read more: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/court-records-should-be-free

item.title: John Jumper to join Anthropic
item.description:
📝 John Jumper@JohnJumperSciA bit of news: After nearly 9 years, I have decided to leave Google DeepMind and join Anthropic (after taking some time to recharge). @demishassabis took a real chance letting me lead the AlphaFold team just six months after finishing my PhD, and the entire GDM team taught me so much about how to do great science. GDM is a special place, and I’ll still be excited to hear about what amazing things they discover next.
🔗 Read more: https://twitter.com/JohnJumperSci/status/2068001285173834106
